sentences.text:
Mohammad Faizan Abbasi @ Faizan Abbasi ... vs State Of U.P.
Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 20 April, 2023

Author: Shamim Ahmed
Bench: Shamim Ahmed
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Court No. - 14
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 422 of 2023
Applicant :- Mohammad Faizan Abbasi @ Faizan Abbasi And Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, U.P. Govt. Civil Sectt. U.P. Lko
Counsel for Applicant :- Mateen Ahmad Khan,Pradeep Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rakesh Kumar Srivastava Hon'ble Shamim Ahmed,J.

Heard Sri Mateen Ahmad Khan, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Rakesh Kumar Srivastava,
learned counsel for opposite party no.2 and Sri Manoj Singh, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State as well as perused the record.

In compliance of the order dated 18.01.2023, the applicant has deposited a demand draft, issued by HDFC Bank, in favour of opposite party no. 2, Smt. Asma Khatoon, amounting Rs.2,50,000/-,
which was retained in safe custody by the Senior Registrar of this Court on 30.01.2023.
The said amount is to be paid to opposite party no. 2, Smt. Asma Khatoon.

Thus, Senior Registrar of this Court is directed to hand over the original draft of Rs. 2,50,000/-, which is in his custody, to opposite party no. 2, Smt. Asma Khatoon today itself and take a receipt on the Photostat of the said demand draft and same may be intimated to this Court within 48 hours and keep the Photostat of the said receipt in the record of the file of the High Court.

entities.text: Mohammad Faizan Abbasi @ Faizan Abbasi ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Sri Mateen Ahmad Khan, learned counsel for the applicants further submits that the remaining amount, as directed by the court below dated 04.03.2021, is being paid regularly to opposite party no. 2.
This fact has already been admitted by Sri Rakesh Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 and he submits that now no dispute remains pending.
Accordingly, they have no objection if the proceedings of the case, pending before the court below, be quashed by this Court, exercising power under Section 482 Cr.P.C.

Sri Manoj Singh, learned AGA for the State also submits that in view of the statements made by learned counsel for the parties, the proceedings of the case, pending before the court below, may be quashed in the interest of justice.

Accordingly, in view of the statements made by learned counsel for the parties, now the dispute has already been resolved and there is already a demand draft in favour of opposite party no. 2, Smt.
Asma Khatoon to the tune of Rs. 2,50,000/- which she will receive today from the Senior Registrar,
High Court, Lucknow Bench, thus, the chargesheet No. 1/2018 dated 30.11.2018 and summoning order dated 18.03.2020 pending before the Judicial Magistrate-II, Lucknow vide Criminal Case No.
575 of 2020, Crime No. 239 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Itanuja, District Lucknow, contained as Annexure nos. 1 and 2 to the application as well as entire proceedings in pursuance thereto
This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is, accordingly, allowed.
Let a computerized copy of this order be issued today and be sent to Senior Registrar of this Court for its necessary compliance.

Order Date :- 20.4.2023 kkv/
